blocks.text: SIBAGAT, Agusan del Sur — Shifting away from synthetic chemicals in their farming practices has not only safeguarded the health of elderly farmers in a remote village here. It has also reduced their household food expenses and provided a steady source of extra income. These developments were told in a video testimonial presented during the 5th Sibagat Organic Agriculture Congress on Wednesday, Nov. 18. Emma P. Dagyom talked about how communal organic farming has transformed their daily lives.
